ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher and flag the driver account for review of "I'm Here" button abuse + flag_account

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's statement that he pressed 'I'm Here' and waited more than 3 minutes at the pickup is contradicted by system records: GPS shows he never came within 200 m of the pickup (closest 288 m) and was 350 m away during both the stationary period and the 'I'm Here' tap; under the system-records-over-statements rule the claim fails NS-1 (ii) and (iii).
Driver's chat 'I'm here already' is contradicted by GPS/timeline records placing him 350 m from the pickup point at the time of the message.
